memories.transcript: My childhood home was a blue bungalow on Maple Street in Portland. We had a cherry tree in the front yard that bloomed every April. My sister Lena and I carved our initials into the porch railing in 1998.

memories.transcript: I worked at Harbor Bakery from 2010 to 2014. My favorite item to bake was cardamom buns on Saturday mornings. The owner, Mr. Patel, taught me to proof dough overnight.
